ios.desc:
Relax, be mindful and Make a square. 

Make a square is a simple yet never before seen puzzle game that trains you to think outside the box. 

It can be super easy to almost impossible and everything in between.

Your brain will start to recognize patterns that were invisible to you before.

It Features:

- Campaign. 
Hand crafted levels which will guide you in your journey from beginner to master.

- Daily levels.
10 new progressively more difficult levels everyday.

- Level editor
Create and play our community levels. Be part of a never ending stream of challenges.

- Procedural levels
Generate infinite levels in any difficulty you want or engineer your creation with the generator tool.

- Hints
Use hints to reveal the solution.


Download it and open your mind to Make a square.
